title: 在同一頁整理動作，用開關決定是否顯示
summary: 動作列與更多改為同頁清單，每個動作都有顯示開關，暫時收起時仍保留位置與排序。
highlights: 移除動作列、更多與隱藏分頁，直接在同一頁搜尋與編輯所有動作。
使用膠囊形顯示開關收起動作，再次開啟時恢復原本的位置與排序。
既有隱藏動作保持關閉，動作列滿九項時會提示，避免意外改動排列。
usage: 開啟設定中的「動作列」，選擇顯示位置並切換「顯示」開關；在搜尋框輸入名稱可快速找到動作。

en.title: Organize actions on one page with visibility switches
en.summary: Toolbar and More actions now share one list. Hide an action with its Show switch while keeping its location and order.
highlights: Search and edit all actions on one page without switching between Toolbar, More, and Hidden tabs.
Use each action's Show switch to hide it and restore its location and order when shown again.
Previously hidden actions stay hidden, and a full nine-action toolbar shows a warning without rearranging other actions.
en.usage: Open Toolbar in Settings, choose a display location, and use the Show switch. Search by name to find an action quickly.
